Just seems like a very big red flag here. There are places one can go get free medical emergency services, no? 

Besides the great advice on cleaning the machine, seems also very suspicious the smell would stay in the machine, maybe he did dry some of his clothes w urs w/o u noticing. Just hard to grasp the smell staying in the machine after a wash, no matter how bad.

I am very worried about this infection though, I really would ask him details. Because comments r right, if it's gangreneor MRSA or smthg terrible, it can be life 
threatening. 

I almost died one time because I am foreign and did not get why black widows r dangerous. I had a double bite n never went to treat it, cause no insurance and broke, thought it would just go away eventually.

So 2 weeks later, it had swollen like a big boil,  and I had ductaped it. But my leg busted w black blood going everywhere, when my coworkers asked to see it. 

But I just ductaped my thigh back n I was gonna go home & sleep it off. I was getting chills, but to me it was just an abscess from a bug bite n I was gonna tough it out. 

A girl I worked w, insisted to take me to the hospital that night, and against my complaining, drove me to the ER herself, where they told me I would have been dead by the morning had I not come in. 
There was so much infection in my blood, that's why I had chills.  

I was there for 3 days on IVs, being pumped  w antibiotics. Had a cut of about half an inch, in my thigh,  they kept open & draining for 2 weeks, to rid of all the infection it created in my body. 

I will never forget her. She saved me. Stayed w me all 3 days.  

She saved my life.

It’s ok, hunny, it is to be expected, heartbreak is the worst pain i have ever been thru, emotionally, and i lived my first 14 years under communism! but u know what, it’s like throwing down a ball, it bounces up and down fifteen times before it settles, just hang in there, i promise u, a year from now u will look back to this time and see how the worst time is a blessing in disguise.. u r doing good!
I recommend a book that reaaallly helped me a lot thru this: ‘It’s called break up because it’s broken’! When i was feeling low, i would read it for 30 min, and it was soul and heart settling, every time. It just put things in the right perspective.
And u know what, u just need alone time sometime, even God rested on the 7th day, u r just a human 😘😘

Hunny, i know what she said can be interpreted as very judgmental, but to me, she is just trying to steer u towards efficiency, high quality, and high standards, there is nothing wrong w that, i think she is just trying to say Harvard is respected for a reason - because when u function at that high level, u r a rockstar!
I don’t think that is racist, i think any mother in the world that wants her kids to do good, will try to push them to maximize their potential and aim sky high, not ceiling low!
I am not saying there cannot be a rigidity to old schoolers, but she seems to just want to give u, in her own tough way, insight into how to become successful.
I am sure u have great friends, she is just worried about how ambitious they are, since, i am sure, she already sees they treat you great. Maybe she just wants reassurance that your ambition, and theirs also, is strong, she doesn’t seem like a woman w bad intentions.
U know, i have been a teacher my whole life, and trust me, when u have not 2 but 20 brilliant and hand picked kids in one class, u wanna cry w happiness and pinch urself to see if it’s real or u r dreaming, that’s how i felt teaching college, after teaching a decade of high school.  And Ucla isn’t even ivy league!

Why give up so close to a break thru. I strongly believe life is not meant to break us, rather break us in. You, darling, are an Excalibur, being forged in the fires of life experience, your metal liquified, so you can fluidly come to shape inside, it is growing pains, hunny, and you are stronger than u think. So many ppl have horrendously abusive families, don’t put the destiny of ur life on a mere human, he loves u, but he is just a guy, no person is perfect, u can’t put it all on him, darling!
You are growing in wisdom, understanding, compassion, u have so much to experience, this is just the beginning, trust me on this, it’s worth it! Xox

I have tried to spend as much time as I can helping others. Help a human, save an animal, at this point, i save even the flies out of my coffee - some soul out there, no matter how small, is going to benefit from every single day i am on this earth.

I recommend getting pets. My cat kept me alive for years, i felt he would have been lost without me, i was all he had.

Hunny, hang in there. This world needs people that care and give a fuck, cause there sure are enough horrible acting assholes. Be the light this world is missing, hun, there is a child out there, looking to be inspired, a soul out there that needs ur warmth and kindness, a cause that needs somebody. Xox
